incident.title: Checkout database unavailable
incident.description: POST /checkout returns 503. MongoWaitQueueTimeoutError occurs after 5000ms with active=20 idle=0 and waiting=84.

cases.knownCause: Pool capped at 20 connections with no idle capacity.

incident.title: Request backlog while acquiring connections
incident.description: Checkout requests queue up at database connection acquisition. The database pool waiting count grows although health checks usually succeed.

cases.knownCause: Pool capped at 20 connections with no idle capacity.

incident.title: Checkout pool saturation
incident.description: Checkout latency spiked while all twenty database connections were busy. Find logs and guidance for connection pressure and safe next checks.

cases.knownCause: Pool capped at 20 connections with no idle capacity.

incident.title: Payment authorization timeout
incident.description: Checkout returns 502 after authorization waits five seconds. Payment TCP connection remains pending and reports ETIMEDOUT.

cases.knownCause: Gateway connection exceeds the configured 5000ms timeout.

incident.title: Gateway connection cannot complete
incident.description: Payments stall before authorization response. A retry was logged followed by PaymentConnectionTimeout during trace pay-301.

cases.knownCause: Gateway connection exceeds the configured 5000ms timeout.

incident.title: Intermittent checkout payment failures
incident.description: Payment health was good earlier but checkout later fails waiting for the external sandbox gateway. Investigate the incident-time evidence.

cases.knownCause: Gateway connection exceeds the configured 5000ms timeout.

incident.title: Existing sessions rejected after deployment
incident.description: Previously valid sessions return 401 immediately after deployment. JwtAudienceMismatch expected shopflow-v2 received shopflow-web.

cases.knownCause: Expected token audience changed from shopflow-web to shopflow-v2.

incident.title: Login configuration drift
incident.description: Token validation rejects browser sessions after auth configuration changed. Distinguish audience mismatch from users entering incorrect passwords.

cases.knownCause: Expected token audience changed from shopflow-web to shopflow-v2.

incident.title: Sudden authorization failures
incident.description: Multiple users lose authentication following release. Compare client token audience and deployed authentication settings.

cases.knownCause: Expected token audience changed from shopflow-web to shopflow-v2.

incident.title: Stock reservation unavailable
incident.description: Checkout cannot reserve stock and receives 503. inventory-service readiness is false and its database connection reports ECONNREFUSED.

cases.knownCause: Inventory database refuses connections and readiness becomes false.

incident.title: Inventory dependency outage
incident.description: Reservations fail even when stock was available. Inspect inventory database connectivity and readiness rather than low stock warnings.

cases.knownCause: Inventory database refuses connections and readiness becomes false.

incident.title: Checkout upstream inventory 503
incident.description: Checkout trace inv-401 stops at inventory reservation. Inventory later recovers; determine what the incident-time connection evidence supports.

cases.knownCause: Inventory database refuses connections and readiness becomes false.

incident.title: Order history latency exceeded
incident.description: GET /orders/history returns 504 after a query takes 9200ms. Explain plan is COLLSCAN with 180000 documents examined and no index.

cases.knownCause: Order history query scans 180000 documents without an index.

incident.title: Orders endpoint degrades with data growth
incident.description: Order history filters customerId and sorts createdAt. Slow query logs show a full scan instead of index access.

cases.knownCause: Order history query scans 180000 documents without an index.

incident.title: Database query latency in checkout
incident.description: History requests exceed the latency budget while normal checkout still succeeds. Investigate inefficient order queries and supporting runbook advice.
